Additive contributions of each record

tl_contributions.Rd

Every metric in tl_metrics() is a ratio of sums, so it can be computed from per-record totals. This function returns those totals, one row per record and detector. They are the unit of resampling in tl_bootstrap().

Usage

tl_contributions(ledger, match = NULL)

Arguments

ledger

A tl_ledger.

match

Optional tl_match from the same ledger.

Details

Durations are in the ledger's time unit. Columns: target (T), known (reference-known, K), answered (answered and reference-known, A), answered_any (answered anywhere in the target), unanswered (abstain, no input or unknown response anywhere in the target), positive_target, positive_known, event (E), event_answered, tp, nonevent_answered, tn, fp_time, known_input and answered_input (reference-known time with input available, and the answered part of it), missed_negative, missed_abstain, missed_no_input, missed_unknown (event time by response), positive_unknown_ref (positive time with unknown reference), and, when match is given, episodes_eligible, episodes_detected, alarms, alarms_matched, alarms_redundant, alarms_false, alarms_unassessable, alarms_ineligible.

Value

A data frame with one row per record and detector.

Examples

fx <- tl_fixture("acceptance")
led <- tl_ledger(fx$records, fx$reference, fx$predictions,
                 time_unit = "min")
tl_contributions(led, tl_match(led))
#>   record detector subject target known answered answered_any unanswered
#> 1   rec1        D    rec1    100   100       80           80         20
#>   positive_target positive_known event event_answered tp nonevent_answered tn
#> 1              20             20    30             10 10                70 60
#>   fp_time known_input answered_input missed_negative missed_abstain
#> 1      10           0              0               0             20
#>   missed_no_input missed_unknown positive_unknown_ref episodes_eligible
#> 1               0              0                    0                 2
#>   episodes_detected alarms alarms_matched alarms_redundant alarms_false
#> 1                 1      2              1                0            1
#>   alarms_unassessable alarms_ineligible
#> 1                   0                 0
